nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Gentle Cream-to-Foam Face Cleanser

avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been really enjoying the first aid beauty ultra gentle cream foam cleanser. It's so gentle on my sensitive, rosacea prone skin and doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped or dry after cleansing. I also really appreciate how it's fragrance free because my skin tends to react to scented products. A foams up nicely. I also like how the pump can be locked, which makes it super convenient to throw in my gym bag and take on the go. Overall, a really simple, gentle cleanser that my skin really likes.

avis.titre: This is NOT the original formula
avis.texte: Guys guys guys, they've written "original formula" on the label, but this is the first formulation of the "Ultra Gentle Pure Skin Face Cleanser." IT IS NOT THE ORIGINAL FORMULATION OF THE "Pure Skin Face Cleanser." I've held onto my packaging from years ago and the ingredients list starts differing at ingredient #6. Maybe this will work for you, who knows, but the one we all loved so dearly is gone, probably for good.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this cleanser and have been using it every day for a few months now. I did wake up with a bunch of tiny zits after the first night I used it, but it hasn't happened since so I don't know if it was related. It feels gentle and I have pretty sensitive skin so it's been goof. I don't wear a ton of makeup, but it's actually done well to remove most of it. I don't know that you can call a normal lather "foam" but it's not some sort of crazy tech - just a cleanser that lathers up with water. I don't know that it's worth the price, it is a pretty small bottle and not any better than any other gentle cleansers I've used in the past

I used this product for YEARS and it worked so wonderfully to remove makeup and help my skin. They changed the formula so I tried it and have been dealing with more breakouts than usual for over a month (and it was the only thing i changed from my routine). I am so disappointed and frustrated. I will not be purchasing again.
Thank god first aid beauty listened and broight back the original. Hoping its as great as before.

It's perfect for sensitive skin and has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. Highly recommend!

Longevity is decent for 6oz, but the value feels low since it didn't help me.

I loved the old formula and had been using it for years! It kept my skin clear as I used to have adult acne and the previous better formula kept all of that gone. Do not recommend using this any longer and will now be looking for something else to clear my skin since this is no longer a holy grail! I hope FAB changes it back and soon!

I have been a FAB fan for years. I have adult acne and it's not uncommon to have a bit of redness to my face. When I started their old formulation of the Ultra Gentle Cleanser, it helped my skin clear up in days. My acne just disappeared. I couldn't believe it. I have very dry skin that if it isn't kept mousitized enough overproduces oil and this old formulation kept that oil at bay. I became someone who told EVERYONE about FAB. I felt like I had found the Holy Grail. But then they changed the formula. I wanted to give them credit so I used a whole bottle. One, it caused me the break out. It wasn't terrible but I definitely had zits and a less smooth face for the first time in years. Two, I found it extremely difficult to get off. The cleanser leaves a weird film on my skin. I don't know if it's intentional or not but I hated how it felt and getting it off included a lot more water and time than before. Third, the oil levels on my skin increased so much. I can't believe how FAB took a perfect cleanser and made it into this. It's such a disappointment and now I'm trying to find something to replace it and failing. If you liked the old formulation, this isn't the one for you anymore.

I felt that the suds of the soap was perfect, it cleaned off all of my makeup which I loved but waterproof mascara was a bit of a task and required extra scrubbing which is why I deducted a ⭐️ because getting this face wash in your eye is NO JOKE AND HURTS SOOO BAD. Aside from that, LOVED the face wash and bonus points for not breaking out after using it!! 👏🏻🎉
I preferred the old formula and I hate the pump bottle. I've got at least a third of the bottle still left that won't come out the pump and I'm left trying to get it out while my face is wet.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive yet oily skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This creamy cleanser first starts as a scent free cream and once you add water, it foams up to thoroughly clean your face. I even tried this to remove eye makeup in a pinch while traveling and it did take off my mascara as needed. Like other First Aid Beauty products, my sensitive skin had zero reaction to this product and I appreciated that is was scent free. However, my skin did feel dry and tight after use so I think this would be awesome for sensitive, more oily skin. I have maturing (50), sensitive skin and it is dryer than before. I can't help but think this would be great for people who are struggling with both sensitivity and acne or oiliness. My husband already "claimed it" for his own.
